 Detailed JD as below 
 We’re looking for a Java Tech Lead / Sr. Developer to help build and maintain spring based java back-end applications, Angular JS and Ext JS web applications and corresponding database processes. He / She should be able to set standards and provide guidance to the other developers in team, prepare design, suggest alternate solutions and track it to implementation. 
 
 This position requires proficiency and experience in core Java and spring framework along with Web Development experience in Angular JS and Ext JS. Exposure / experience in BFS domain, AWS technology would be added advantage. Strong communication skills and right attitude is necessary. 
 
 Requirements 
 • Very strong core java skills – Collections, Multi-Threading, Design patterns, OOPs concepts 
 • Strong skills in Spring framework 
 • Web Technologies - Angular JS, Ext JS, Java script 
 • Database – Oracle, MySQL 
 • Java Messaging – Active MQ, IBM MQ 
 • Web container - Tomcat 
 • Must be hands-on person 
 • Thorough knowledge of Junit and/or Mockito 
 • Tools - JIRA, Jenkins, Git, Source Tree, IntelliJ, STS, Eclipse, Maven 
 • Well versed of agile methodology 
 • Should have working knowledge of web services, java 7/8 
 • Should have ability to design the framework and able to participate in design discussions with client architect 
 • Should be able to drive a team 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
